build.environment: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS under WSL, TeX Live 2023, pdfTeX 1.40.25, latexmk 4.83, Poppler 24.02.0
build.result: Two clean builds from the final extracted archive produced byte-identical PDFs with no final LaTeX or layout warnings. Inspected PNG renders of all twelve pages and checked the abstract and title against metadata.

fixed_prime.result: Checked the coherent return and exact rational moment in four cases (p,N) = (5,31), (5,781), (11,133), (17,307). At (5,31), the orbit calculation gives 5-rank 42 and the digit calculation counts six eligible labels. The order-504 top coefficient is one modulo five.

fixed_cover.result: The four retained prime-cube examples have residues 182, 186, 23, 46. At n=35, exhausts the 24 unit classes, checking the seven nonsplit certifying classes and detecting a quotient-dimension mismatch at every nonidentity class. At (p,iterate) = (29,2), (43,4), (79,6), (3,12), (29,4) the direct and translated residues match as 1, 14, 67, 0, 1.

replays.scope: Replayed the four programs with archive verifier bytes matching the final archive. The older Python calculations replay finite examples; the moving-branch computation verifies rational identities in the parameters. The uniform cutoff and period-theoretic implications use written proofs.

moving_branch.result: SageMath 10.9 checked all three rational identities against the complete coefficient matrices for odd degrees 1, 3 and 4 from archived verifier bytes.

marked_rank.result: Checked conductor-54 and conductor-162 rank bounds and dimensions, the 229 block determinant 137, the rigidity congruence 26 and the allowed marker counts for interpolation.

literature: Bouw, Definition 2.1, Lemmas 4.3 and 5.1 and Theorem 6.1 (character dimensions, stable rank, coefficient formula and the generic bound).
Li, Mantovan, Pries and Tang (2019), Theorem 3.2 (Newton slopes for tame three-branch cyclic covers).
SGA 7 I, Expose IX, (12.3.7) and section 12.4 (the dual-graph lattice of the torus).
Serre and Tate, Theorems 1 and 6 (good reduction via inertia and potential good reduction for CM).
Moonen, sections 2.1, 2.5 and 3.1 (coherent Frobenius, the Hasse–Witt triple and the a-number).

pdf_only_internal_review.context: The reader opened only two successive compiled PDFs with the neutral manuscript prompts, without repository proof notes or certificate code. The digest identifies the later of those two PDFs.
findings: Recovered the two nonordinary families, the residue criteria and the exact 5-rank argument.
Recovered the moving-branch residue reduction and identified the exact coefficient-span calculation as an essential supplementary artifact.
Distinguished the effective reconstruction window, one-step block rank and a-number bounds, stable rank, and conditional local rigidity.
Flagged missing input and good-reduction hypotheses, an unnamed supplement, and a widow in the interpolation paragraph.
pdf_only_internal_review.revisions_and_rechecks: The final source specifies the rational parameter family and tame branch conditions, names the bundled verifier, defines the balanced lift, names the two opposite phases, and keeps the interpolation paragraph together. The final reflow was rebuilt and rendered internally. The isolated reader did not review the final PDF digest.

review.remaining_work: External specialist review of the toric and coherent reductions, exact reconstruction identities, and marked-rank interpretation.
